extDescription.message: Set your volume once. Volume Guard auto-lowers loud scenes and raises quiet dialogue so movies stay at your level.

commandToggle.message: Turn Volume Guard on or off

toggleMaster.message: Turn Volume Guard on or off

siteRestrictedHint.message: Open a video page to use Volume Guard.

siteAlwaysOnHint.message: Runs automatically each time you visit.

siteAlwaysOffHint.message: Active on this tab. Turn on to keep it on every visit.

statusNoMedia.message: No video detected on this page

statusBlockedDrm.message: This video is copy-protected, so its audio can't be adjusted directly. Playback is untouched. Try compatibility mode below.

statusBlockedCors.message: This site blocks access to the video's audio. Playback is untouched. Try compatibility mode below.

statusBlockedInUse.message: The page already controls this video's audio. Playback is untouched. Try compatibility mode below.

statusBlockedUnsupported.message: This kind of video isn't supported. Playback is untouched.

statusError.message: Something went wrong. Playback is untouched.

statusRestricted.message: Volume Guard can't run on this page.

statusNoAccess.message: Volume Guard can't access this page.

optionsSubtitle.message: Set it once. Watch in peace.

optionsReactionHelp.message: Smooth keeps changes gentle. Instant reacts the moment a scene gets loud.

optionsMaxBoostHelp.message: How much quiet scenes may be turned up. Higher values can amplify background noise.

optionsBoostWarning.message: A high boost can be uncomfortable and amplify noise. A limiter always protects your ears.

optionsMaxReductionHelp.message: How much loud scenes may be turned down.

optionsLimiterHelp.message: Catches sudden peaks before they reach your ears.

optionsSitesHelp.message: Sites where Volume Guard is allowed to run automatically. You can pause or remove any of them.

optionsNoSites.message: No sites yet. Open a video page and turn on “Always on” in the popup.

optionsShortcutHelp.message: Turn correction on or off from any page.

optionsPrivacyText.message: Audio is analysed on your device and is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere. Volume Guard has no analytics and makes no network requests.

compatHint.message: Levels the whole tab's audio so protected videos work too. May add a tiny delay to the sound.

compatActiveHint.message: On: this tab's audio is being levelled.

compatDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so compatibility mode stays off.

compatError.message: Couldn't start compatibility mode on this tab. Try again after pressing play.
